mats._what: Poké Ball floor sign, left half (Black 2's own Center floor logo)
right half: the rect reversed in x and z turns the texture 180 degrees (the half ball is symmetric top to bottom), which keeps the quad facing up (a mirror would face down and be culled)

counter top: Black 2's own Center counter colour (in02_pc's orange-red column, set 283, as chunk 827 draws its counter; the floor's cream made it vanish), 2 units above the counters' own tops; 16 above the floor and its front edge 1.5 units back from the row's south edge: the Center camera (zone header camera 3) looks down only 31.75 degrees and gives people no depth margin, so a higher top or one reaching the edge is drawn across the heads of people standing in front (indoor_check, rooms_view.py kind m)
counter top right of the nurse
